Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Role: Senior DevOps Engineer 
 Location: Bucharest - Romania - Hybrid/ Remote 
 Type: Full-time (Not available for Contracts) 
 Salary: Negotiable 
 Mandatory Skills: Terraform, Kubernetes, GitHub Actions, Experience in application migration from on-prem to cloud, Public cloud experience (GCP/AWS/Azure – GCP preferred) 
 Role: 
 We are looking for motivated Candidates to join our team, working on building automated CI/CD pipelines, supporting migration of applications from on-prem to Google Cloud, and delivering concepts for policy-as-code in GCP. 
 Responsibilities: 
 • Design, build, and maintain scalable, secure, and high-availability infrastructure on the GCP Cloud platform
 • Manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform.
 • Develop and optimise CI/CD pipelines to ensure smooth, efficient and reliable data workload releases using GitHub Actions
 • Deliver high-quality software and to be passionate about software engineering
 • Automate repetitive tasks and processes to improve efficiency and reduce errors.
 • Develop and maintain scripts for infrastructure automation, monitoring and deployments
 • Implement and enforce security best practices across the infrastructure and deployment processes
 • Understand the SDLC process and controls (policies)
 • Design/Implement automated CI/CD pipelines to satisfy and close the SDLC Controls
 • Support PB teams to get onboarded to Google Cloud and GitHub
 • Support PB teams to configure and implement the pipelines
 • Document knowledge base articles and other materials as required
 Technical Skills: 
 • Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code - Terraform (must)
 • Proficiency in cloud platforms such as Google Cloud (preferred), AWS or Azure
 • Usage of enterprise Security Management solutions, including GCP Secret Manager
 • Experience in CI/CD tools
 • GitHub Actions – CI/CD experience would be a plus
 • Experience with Docker/Kubernetes (creating images, deployments)
 • Experience in developing Helm Charts ( templates, hooks, packaging)
 • Exposure to delivering good-quality code within enterprise-scale development
 • Working knowledge of environment monitoring tools such as GCO, New Relic, Prometheus, Grafana
 • Strong experience in software development processes, models, lifecycles and methodologies.
 • Expert hands-on experience with service-mesh technology such as Istio or similar products
 • Experience in software development and scripting in at least one language (Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, Bash)
 Soft Skills: 
 • Strong written and verbal communication skills at all levels of the project team.
 • Prioritises and manages time to deliver on commitments;
 • Multiple languages preferred (English is mandatory, German is a plus);
 • Experience working in an international environment.
